summary: Verified new trust_enrichment.py module + extract_jobs integration + TrustViewerTwoPanel educational-section rendering. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_trust_enrichment.py with 5 tests: (a) no-LLM-key fallback returns 9 canonical sections, (b) LLM-exception fallback, (c) LLM-timeout fallback, (d) live LLM path with real EMERGENT_LLM_KEY produces substantive personalized content, (e) seeded case 8eb42bd3 E2E has exactly 6 article + 9 educational = 15 sections in order with canonical titles. All 5 PASS (108s incl. live LLM). Frontend Playwright verified: 15 sections rendered (data-testid trust-section-0..14), last 9 carry class 'igc-edu', 9 '.igc-edu-eyebrow' cards showing 'Client Education', 9 '.igc-explain-label-edu' right-panel labels with '📘 <Title> — Plain English', NO tabs / NO load-more / single continuous scroll flow, gold-tinted sand→cream gradient differentiates edu cards.
critical_code_review_comments: trust_enrichment.py: fallback path is well-designed — always returns exactly 9 sections keyed by canonical SECTION_SPECS ordering even if LLM returns fewer/none. Good defensive coding.
trust_enrichment.py:163-166 catches asyncio.TimeoutError separately from generic Exception — good logging separation.
extract_jobs.py:116-128 correctly wraps enrichment in try/except so an LLM failure does NOT fail the whole extract job. Verified by the fallback tests which would have crashed the job otherwise.

Minor: `_parse_json_lenient` uses non-greedy `.*` inside `{.*}` — if Claude ever returns two JSON blocks this regex could pick up nested braces incorrectly. Not a bug in practice but worth a follow-up.
TrustViewerTwoPanel.jsx correctly renders left + right educational cards in the SAME map/render loop — no separate scroll container, confirmed by absence of tabs and single continuous DOM order.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://trust-intake-portal.preview.emergentagent.com EMERGENT_LLM_KEY=<key> && pytest /app/backend/tests/test_trust_enrichment.py -v` (~2 min incl. live Claude call). The E2E test in test_trust_enrichment.py::TestSeededCaseE2E depends on case 8eb42bd3 remaining in DB with its published 15 sections; do not delete.
